metadata.title: EestiHub - Estonia tax and housing insights
metadata.description: Compare Estonian tax regimes and explore Tallinn rental data for expats and entrepreneurs.

header.tagline: Estonia essentials for builders and expats

hero.title: Make your move to Tallinn add up.
hero.description: See what a salary is worth after Estonian taxes, what rent costs across Tallinn's districts, and what an e-resident company takes to run — in English, Estonian or Russian.

example.title: Live example
example.description: See how the four Estonian tax regimes compare on the same salary, with the 2026 EMTA rates behind every number.

steps.title: Three tools for one move
steps.description: Each tool answers one question and shows where its numbers come from.

income.title: What you keep
income.text: Compare four ways of getting paid in Estonia: net income, payer cost and the effective tax rate.

housing.title: What rent costs
housing.text: Published 1–3-room rent midpoints for Tallinn's eight districts, with capture dates; utilities are shown as a separate estimate.

eresidency.title: What a company costs
eresidency.text: First-year setup and running costs for an e-resident OÜ, built from official fees.

transparency.title: Sources and estimates
transparency.text: Tax rates follow EMTA's 2026 table and e-Residency fees come from the official knowledge base. District rents are midpoints of published Tallinn ranges, each with its capture date. Utility costs are our own estimate, not a published figure, and the rent dashboard labels them separately.

metadata.title: Monthly budget planner - EestiHub
metadata.description: Turn an Estonian salary into a monthly housing allowance: net income, spending, savings and a housing share.

hero.title: From salary to housing allowance.
hero.description: Enter employment income or a manual net, protect everyday spending and savings, and see what is left for rent and utilities. The backend calculates every number.

form.incomeDescription: An Estonian employment salary is converted with the 2026 tax engine. Choose manual net when those assumptions do not fit.
form.invalidGross: Enter a gross salary greater than 0 and at most 1,000,000.
form.invalidNet: Enter a net income of 0 or more and at most 1,000,000.
form.budgetDescription: Explicit choices, including zero. Rent and utilities share one allowance.
form.invalidSpending: Enter spending of 0 or more and at most 1,000,000.
form.invalidSavings: Enter a savings target of 0 or more and at most 1,000,000.

empty.title: No budget yet
empty.description: Submit the form to see net income, both limits and the final housing allowance.

stale.title: Outdated result
stale.text: Inputs changed after this calculation. Submit again for current numbers.

errors.title: Calculation failed
errors.api: The API rejected the request. Check the input and try again.
errors.network: The backend is unavailable. Start the FastAPI service locally and try again.
errors.validationTitle: Check the highlighted fields, then submit again.

results.title: Your housing budget

warnings.commitments_exceed_income: Monthly spending plus savings are higher than net income, so the allowance is €0.00. Amounts stay visible — nothing was reduced silently.
warnings.utilities_incomplete: Some utility amounts are unknown, so seasonal totals cannot be completed.
warnings.move_in_incomplete: Some move-in costs are unknown, so the cash total is incomplete.

results.housingContext: See Tallinn district averages as general context
results.housingNote: District figures are monthly averages, not listings.

assumptions.title: Calculation assumptions
assumptions.employment: Employment salary uses the existing employment-contract calculation with equal gross, never the highest-net regime.
assumptions.allowance: Allowance is the smaller of money left after commitments and the share limit; a negative remainder stays visible.

unsaved.confirm: Budget inputs are not saved. Leave this page without calculating?

disclaimer.title: An estimate, not financial advice
disclaimer.text: The allowance follows your own spending and savings choices, not an official cost-of-living recommendation. Tax figures use Estonia's 2026 rates.
